name: LS Stock Portfolio
author: lakestylez

sections.description:
LS Stock Portfolio lets you embed your image portfolio from Adobe Stock, Unsplash, or Pixabay directly into your WordPress site.

The plugin supports:
– Adobe Stock Contributor pages (via URL)
– Unsplash user profiles (via API key)
– Pixabay image libraries (via API key + custom tags)

It automatically fetches your images (with caching), displays them in a responsive masonry grid and includes an integrated Lightbox with clean author credits and links required by the respective platforms.

No external dependencies. No theme conflicts.
Just install, connect, embed — done.

Features

  • Multi-platform support:
    • Adobe Stock (Contributor URL)
    • Unsplash (user & API key)
    • Pixabay (API key + custom tag filters)
  • Masonry grid layout
  • Integrated Lightbox (no external plugin required)
  • Automatic photographer / author credits with backlinks
  • Load more functionality
  • Caching for speed & rate limits
  • Adjustable:
    • Number of initial images
    • Columns
    • Gaps
    • Sorting (original / random)
    • Language (DE / EN)
  • Backend PayPal donation button
  • Lightweight, stable and performance-focused
  • No jQuery required
  • Compatible with all themes & page builders

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on external image services to fetch and display portfolio images. When you enable the corresponding platform, LS Stock Portfolio sends HTTP requests from your server to the respective API or website:

  1. Adobe Stock

    • Website: https://stock.adobe.com
    • Terms of Use: https://www.adobe.com/legal/terms.html
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.adobe.com/privacy/policy.html

  2. Unsplash

    • Website: https://unsplash.com
    • API Documentation: https://unsplash.com/documentation
    • Terms of Service: https://unsplash.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://unsplash.com/privacy

  3. Pixabay

    • Website: https://pixabay.com
    • API Documentation: https://pixabay.com/api/docs/
    • Terms of Service: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/

Requests are made server-to-server and may include standard technical information such as your server IP address and user agent string as part of normal HTTPS traffic. The plugin does not intentionally send any personally identifiable information about logged-in users or site visitors to these services.

Shortcode Examples

Default: [lsmsp_stock_portfolio]
English output: [lsmsp_stock_portfolio lang=”en”]

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file and install it.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. In the dashboard, open “Stock Portfolio”.
  6. Choose your platform:
    • Adobe Stock → paste Contributor URL
    • Unsplash → enter username + API key
    • Pixabay → enter API key + tags
  7. Configure grid, sorting and lightbox options.
  8. Insert the shortcode [lsmsp_stock_portfolio] into any page.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require Simple Lightbox?

No. LS Stock Portfolio now includes its own Lightbox, fully integrated and optimized.

How often are images refreshed?

By default every 6 hours.
The interval can be changed in the plugin settings.

Can I embed multiple profiles at once?

Currently no — one portfolio per site installation.
(Multi-instance support is planned for a future update.)

Are Unsplash / Pixabay credits included?

Yes.
Credits & backlinks are automatically generated based on the API response — compliant with platform requirements.

  • UI improvements in backend

  • Adobe Stock support + shortcode
